description: The shows this key is kept current on. Every charged fetch makes its show a follow: the five most-fetched shows from the last 180 days are followed automatically (source 'fetch'), and up to 25 more can be declared with follow_podcast (source 'explicit'). Muted shows are listed separately. Use list_new_episodes to see what is new on them. Does not consume credits; the demo key has nothing to follow with.
name: list_following

newest_fetched_id.description: Newest episode fetched; list_new_episodes lists what came after it.

podcast_id.description: Show id; pass it to list_episodes or follow_podcast.

source.description: 'fetch': followed automatically from fetches. 'explicit': declared with follow_podcast.

explicit.description: Most shows that can be declared with follow_podcast.

podcast_id.description: Show id; pass it to list_episodes or follow_podcast.

title: List followed shows
